title: Multi-Agent LLMs as Ethics Advocates for AI based Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating whether the multi-agent LLM successfully generates fairness requirements addressing the equitable handling of different Arabic dialects (e.g., Modern Standard Arabic vs. dialectal Arabic) compared to human-elicited baselines.

Measuring the LLM's recall and precision in generating ethics requirements that ensure system accuracy across various demographic groups, including different age groups, genders, skin colors, and body builds.

Assessing the LLM's ability to elicit fairness requirements that account for culturally specific attire (e.g., women wearing hijabs or niqabs) and other appearances (e.g., gloves, face masks) in the training data of a sign language translation application.
Analyzing the LLM-generated requirements for the inclusion of features that address diverse cognitive and sensory abilities to prevent exclusion in a sign language translation system.
